name: @yahalla/local-runtime
description: Yahalla AI local-first Agent Runtime: runs entirely on the user's own device. Owns the local LLM process, tool execution, memory/knowledge/skills, permissions, and tasks. No cloud LLM, no tunnel, no dependency on any other machine.
